dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Continuous 2D geometric narrowing from the maximum width at the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Generally smooth lateral margins with a subtle asymmetrical convex deviation on the right edge relative to the left.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to off-white median pixel intensity across the primary dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Diffuse dark-grey clusters of low spatial frequency distributed along the lateral margins and the posterior dorsal segment.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes between the lighter central dorsal canvas and the darker pigmented lateral regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A prominent, shadow-casting longitudinal furrow located on the anterior dorsal plane, offset to the left of the central axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct longitudinal linear groove or scar on the left anterior dorsal quadrant.
